subject: Geopolitics
title: Social Media as a Battlefield
description: A fast breakdown of Social Media as a Battlefield for builders.

hook.text: Facebook's algorithm promotes outrage because outrage drives engagement. States exploit this for free amplification.

buildup.text: Social media platforms reward emotional content with visibility. Disinformation is more engaging than facts.

discovery.text: MIT research found that false news reaches people six times faster than true stories on Twitter.

twist.text: Platforms profit from engagement regardless of truth. Fixing the problem means reducing their own revenue.

climax.text: Social media turned information warfare from a state project into an open arena.

punchline.text: Build a platform for connection. Watch it become a weapon.

quiz.question: Why does disinformation spread faster than truth on social media?
options: Social media algorithms block all truthful content
Emotional and false content drives more engagement
Only disinformation creators can afford advertising
